faq.metaDescription: Common questions about working with JG Creative Tech - services, getting started, payment, and the client portal.
faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Answers to what most people ask before working with us. Still have a question? Reach out directly.
faq.q1Question: What does JG Creative Tech actually do?
faq.q1Answer: We build digital infrastructure for Kenyan and East African SMEs - web development, digital architecture, digital strategy, and editorial-grade design. In practice that means everything from a business's core website to the systems behind it: client portals, payment processing, and ongoing technical strategy.
faq.q2Question: How do I get started on a project?
faq.q2Answer: Click "Get Started" from the homepage. You'll fill out a short Project Discovery form (your goals, business stage, and any context worth knowing), then choose a time for a consultation call. Nothing is booked or charged until that call.
faq.q3Question: How much does a project cost?
faq.q3Answer: It depends on scope - a marketing website and a custom client portal are very different projects. We don't publish fixed packages because most real projects don't fit a template. Book a consultation and we'll give you an honest, specific estimate based on what you actually need.
faq.q4Answer: Yes. Invoices in your client portal can be paid by M-Pesa or card through a single secure checkout - you choose the method that works for you at the time of payment.
faq.q5Question: Do you only work with businesses in Nairobi?
faq.q5Answer: No. We're based in Nairobi, but our work is entirely remote-friendly and we work with SMEs across Kenya and East Africa more broadly.
faq.q6Question: What is the client portal, and do I get access to one?
faq.q6Answer: It's where active clients view project documents, track invoices, pay them, and message our team directly, all in one place. Portal access is set up for you once you become a client - there's no public sign-up.
faq.q7Question: Is your site and your service available in Swahili?
faq.q7Answer: Yes - the site itself is fully available in English and Swahili, and we're happy to communicate in either language throughout a project.
faq.q8Question: What's the fastest way to reach you directly?
faq.q8Answer: WhatsApp is usually fastest - there's a chat button on every page. You can also use the contact form, or book a consultation directly if you already know what you're looking for.
